definition: the generally accepted fashion, style, manner etc. in a particular country or region.
example_en: This custom is the accepted fashion of that region.

definition: a round object used for winding the thread around by weavers.
example_en: Grandmother was winding the thread on the weaver's spool.

definition: the fact or quality of being dual; duality.

example_en: People got confused seeing the duality in his words.

definition: an abnormally lean body.

definition: to widen; to broaden.

definition: a sage of highest rank.

definition: a public sale or the system of selling, of an item to the highest bidder; auction.

definition: the eastern mountain behind which the sun, moon, and stars appear to rise from.
example_en: The sun appeared at the eastern mountain of sunrise.

definition: the act of commending; commendation; praise.
example_en: His work received commendation at the meeting.

definition: a place earmarked for parking carts or chariots.
example_en: The king's soldiers parked the carts in the cart-parking place.

definition: a man lacking vigour, vitality.

definition: to whirl a sling with a stone placed in it.
example_en: The boy whirled the sling with a stone and threw the stone far.

definition: the length of the arm from the end of the middle finger to the elbow, used as a unit of linear measure.

definition: the external covering of the woody stems and branches of plants, that is separable from the wood; bark.

definition: a man who supports, encourages scholars.

definition: a large number of bangles bunched together.
example_en: A large bunch of colourful bangles jingled on her arm.

definition: not near; distant (in space or time); far off; remote.

definition: a primary or principle rule, condition.
example_en: This rule is the primary principle of the scripture.

definition: to carry the burden on one's head, shoulder, back, etc.
example_en: The labourer carries the sacks on his back.

definition: having a smooth and even surface; flat.

definition: the act of translating a text, book, speech, etc. from one language into another; translation.
example_en: The translation of this book was very difficult.

definition: any of several types of light vehicle mounted on runners for use on snow, ice, etc.; a sled or sleigh; a sledge.
example_en: The sled moved through the snow.

definition: one who has attained the age of youth.
example_en: That young man stood ready for battle.

definition: an illogical argument; an argument on unimportant or unwanted issue.
example_en: No one accepted his illogical argument.

definition: a skin disease characterised by whitish, reddish or blackish spots.

definition: a container, usu. of rectangular shape, having a moveable lid, made of tin, metal sheet, etc.; a box.

definition: sister of one's mother.

definition: the quality or condition of being continuous; continuousness.
example_en: Continuousness was seen in that music concert.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.

definition: a deaf man.
example_en: That deaf man used to speak through gestures.

definition: tender or doting affection; fondness.
example_en: The grandmother had great fondness for her grandson.

definition: the nose, that perceives smell.
example_en: He smelled the fragrance with his nose.

definition: any of the insects of Blattaria order, with long antennae and a flat, soft body, some species of which are common household pests; a cockroach.
example_en: A cockroach appeared in the bathroom.

definition: a female dancer.
example: ಆ ನರ್ತಕಿ ವೇದಿಕೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಕುಣಿದಳು.
example_en: That female dancer danced beautifully on the stage.

definition: a contingent of policemen, armed force, etc. guarding a place.
example_en: A police guard post was set up outside the town.

definition: the hair of a horse's tail.
example_en: The horse's tail-hair looked beautiful fluttering in the wind.

definition: a set of two similar or corresponding things; a pair.

definition: the quality of contracting or tending to contract.

definition: a woman who describes or gives descriptive representations; a describer.

example_en: That woman describer portrayed village life well.

definition: to see and understand clearly the inner nature of things; to have intuition.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಳಗುಗಾಣುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: From the guru's words, he gained the ability to see the inner truth clearly.

definition: a man not induced by or not inclined to, sleep.
example_en: That guard kept watch without falling asleep.

definition: the act of playing a percussion instrument rhythmically with one's hands or a stick or sticks.
example_en: The musician's drumming enchanted the audience.

definition: a letter, paper, document, etc. that is not genuine; a forged paper or letter.

definition: a meditating on music and musical phrases and their sounds.
example_en: He sat absorbed in meditating on musical sounds and phrases.

definition: to immerse, dip (an object) in water or any other liquid.

definition: a man with pleasing appearance; a handsome man.

definition: having embroidery work done with gold, silver or silk threads).

example_en: Without grasping the right meaning of his words, I fell silent.

definition: the tree Ailanthus excels ( = Callosities indica, = Bignonia indica) of Simaroubaceae family.

definition: lively, joyous play; amusement; light sport.

definition: a small, steep waterfall; a cascade.

definition: a person descended or regarded as descended, from the ancient Hebrews of Biblical times; a jew.

definition: a mass of iron of any shape.

definition: to set or fix in the ground; to plant.

definition: any one of the system of thick-walled blood vessels that carry blood away from the heart; an artery.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard; to defend; to protect.

definition: the act of ending; an end.

definition: something made by mixing of different ingredients; a mixture.

definition: a kind of thorny shrub.

definition: a eating of flesh.

definition: a man guarding a fort.

definition: a man who acts in consonance with another's wish or desire.

definition: the peak or apex.

definition: an erstwhile monetary coin.

definition: to shrink from heat, weight, etc.

definition: a brave, daring or adventurous man.

definition: darkly; blackly; gloomingly.

definition: brightness; brilliance; lustre; radiance.

definition: to clasp; to embrace; to hug.

definition: quality of being based on observation or experience; empiricism.

definition: the quality of being easy to do, perform, understand, etc.; easiness.

definition: that resists any acid; acid-proof.

definition: the mature female of domestic cattle; a cow.

definition: a solution of alcohol or of alcohol and water, containing animal, vegetable or chemical drugs; tincture.

definition: a shriek sound; scream.

definition: a kind of drum, a percussion instrument.

definition: the quality or condition of being obscure; obscurity.
example_en: The obscurity of that incident was never resolved.

definition: a man given to merry-making and enjoyment.

definition: the plant Sesamum indicum of Asteraceae family.

definition: difficult to be carried or borne; insufferable; unbearable; intolerable.

definition: a face of red complexion.

definition: rudeness of manners; absence of civility or culture; barbarism.

definition: the tree Manilkara kauki ( = Mimuspos kauki) of Sapotaceae family.

definition: the act of remembering; a recalling to the mind; recollection; remembrance.

definition: a very slow pace.

definition: the act of fusing, soldering, attaching two or more things together or inlaying something into the surface of another.

definition: the number expressing unity or designating a single unit; the lowest cardinal number; one; 1.

definition: he who protects, safeguards.

definition: three quarters of a whole.

definition: a relatively big passage of water; a big canal.

example_en: He learnt the poem by heart.

definition: the form or shape of anything.
example_en: The shape of that cloth had come out well.

definition: a long stick used to thresh grain; a flail.
example_en: The farmer threshed the paddy with a flail.

definition: a kind of sword or dagger.
example_en: He drew the sword from its sheath.

definition: being in between the thirty-ninth and forty one; fortieth.
example_en: Everyone came on his fortieth birthday.

definition: a heavy wooden post used as a weapon.
example_en: The thieves broke the door with a heavy wooden post.

definition: in a simple, lucid manner or style.
example_en: He spoke in a simple, lucid manner.

definition: the quality of being ancient or old; antiquity.
example: ಈ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಪಳಮೆ ಸಾವಿರ ವರ್ಷಗಳಷ್ಟು ಹಳೆಯದು.
example_en: The antiquity of this text is as old as a thousand years.

definition: the state of being somewhat dark; dimness.
example_en: Someone was walking in the dim forest.

definition: to slip down away from the hand, fingers, etc.; to escape from a hold, seizure.
example_en: That snake slipped away from the grip.

definition: the quality or state of being irregular; irregularity; casualness.
example_en: There was always irregularity in his arrival.

definition: the plant Canna indica of Cannaceae family.
example_en: She planted a canna plant in the pot.

definition: a hollow or hollowed-out place; cavity; a hole.
example: ಗುಡ್ಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ತೂಂಬು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small cavity on the hill.

definition: (pl.) new or young leaves (of a plant).
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ತಳಿರು ಚಿಗುರಿತು.
example_en: After the rains came, new leaves sprouted on the tree.

definition: a room designed to store grain; a barn.
example_en: Sacks of paddy were stacked in the barn.

definition: a kind of creeper.
example_en: The sōtuvalli creeper had spread along the hillside.

definition: to tremble; to shiver.
example_en: The child was trembling with fear.

definition: the work of ornamenting fabric with needlework.
example_en: The grandmother was skilled in the work of ornamenting fabric with needlework.

definition: a cord made by intertwisting two or more strands together.
example_en: The farmer tied the ox firmly with a twisted rope.

definition: (growth of someone or something) to be checked; to have stunted growth.
example_en: Due to lack of manure, the crop's growth was stunted.

definition: to cause to play well.
example_en: Grandfather brought a toy to make the grandchild play well.

definition: (phil.) the illusory nature the body or phenomenal reality.
example_en: The sage taught the disciples about the illusory nature of the body.

definition: a record keeper in a government office.
example_en: The record keeper had kept all the documents carefully.

definition: a wild, strong porcupine.
example_en: In the forest, the strong porcupine stood with its quills spread out.

definition: a mendicant fortune-teller.
example_en: The mendicant fortune-teller came into the street and told fortunes.

definition: to hypnotise; to spellbind.
example_en: The magician hypnotised the snake.

definition: a story - a) an account of imaginary or past events; a narrative, tale or anecdote; b) a fictitious literary composition in prose or poetry, shorter than a novel; narrative; tale; c) the narrative or plot of a novel or play etc.; storyline.
example_en: The storyline of this novel is very interesting.

definition: an envious man.
example_en: Being an envious man, he could not bear his neighbour's success.

definition: to flow in a stream swiftly.
example_en: The stream flowed swiftly down from the hill.

definition: any worm that moves by crawling along the ground.
example_en: The crawling worm moved slowly along the ground.

definition: previously; in the preceding part; above.
example_en: This matter has been explained previously (above).

definition: whisper - a) something whispered b) a secret, hint, rumour, etc.
example_en: The whispered hint she gave turned out to be true.

definition: an able, strong man.
example: ಆ ಗಡಸುಗಾಱ ಭಾರವಾದ ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಎತ್ತಿದನು.
example_en: That able, strong man lifted the heavy stone easily.

definition: to lose consciousness temporarily.
example_en: He momentarily lost consciousness standing in the hot sun.
